prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1421; do not mention it.)
text: This firm represents the above-named individual in connection with injuries sustained in a motor vehicle collision involving your insured at an intersection, in which your insured's vehicle struck our client's vehicle broadside. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter, including requests for statements, medical authorizations, and settlement discussions, exclusively to this office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you or anyone acting on your behalf. Please provide, within the time allowed under applicable law, the declarations page and the full liability limits of the policy under which your insured is covered, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair or total-loss records, adjuster notes, and any telematics or dashcam footage. Failure to preserve such material may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
